register.labelZh: SIGN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: sign in 和 sign somebody in 可用來描述酒店、辦公室、學校、活動場地和保安大樓的登記程序。；sign off 可用來結束信件、電郵、廣播節目、視像通話或網上訊息。；你可以 sign completed work off,表示批准已完成的工作;也可以 sign off on a plan,表示正式批准一項計劃。；SIGN 片語動詞可以表示報名參加課程、借用設備、簽收包裹或正式轉讓財產。
register.summaryEn: Sign in and sign somebody in help you describe what happens at hotels, offices, schools, events and secure buildings. Sign off is useful when ending a letter, email, broadcast, video call or online message. You can sign completed work off or sign off on a new plan, report or proposal. The SIGN family can describe joining a course, borrowing equipment, receiving a parcel or legally transferring property.
contextsZh: 清楚談論到達登記和訪客紀錄
自然地結束訊息和節目
分辨不同種類的正式批准
描述報名、借用、收件和轉讓
contextsEn: Talk clearly about arrivals and visitor records
Describe joining, borrowing, receiving and transferring

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；使用 him、her、it 或 them 時,請按照以上例子放在正確位置。；注意以下意思相近的表達:● sign in 表示登記某人已到達;sign up 或 sign on 表示報名或加入。● sign something off 表示批准已完成的工作、帳單或費用;sign off on something 表示批准計劃、報告或建議。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. When using him, her, it or them, place the word as shown: sign him in sign it off sign it out sign it over sign her up Do not confuse these similar expressions: ● sign in records someone’s arrival; sign up or sign on means joining. ● sign something off approves completed work, bills or expenses; sign off on something approves a plan, report or proposal.
